facts.fact: DCD reports Cote d'Ivoire has a small private data centre market with a handful of data centres in Abidjan; operators include Equinix, Raxio, ST Digital, Paix Data Centres and Stellarix (no facility names, as of article date).
facts.system: Abidjan commercial data centres (Equinix, Raxio, ST Digital, Paix Data Centres, Stellarix)

note: State centre is planned for 2027 and for government bodies only: not a fact.
